method: Read British Library primary catalogue and EAP metadata, inspect the documented IIIF v3 manifest, download only public image/jpeg bodies and inspect each downloaded image locally. No application code, application, server, browser or tests were run. No anti-bot bypass was used.

licenseEvidence.evidence: The item-specific HTML includes the CC BY-NC 4.0 hyperlink and a data-uri pointing to this manifest. The manifest rights field repeats this URL. Its body identifiers supply the exact downloaded JPEG URLs.
licenseEvidence.restrictions: Noncommercial restriction and attribution apply. Preserve author/creator, British Library shelfmark, original custodian and source. The presence of a licence does not establish that the exact destination is pictured.
licenseEvidence.creator: Khorezmian Archaeological-Ethnographic Expedition of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR
licenseEvidence.originalCustodian: Institute of Ethnology and Anthropology, Russian Academy of Sciences, Moscow, Russian Federation
licenseEvidence.funding: Endangered Archives Programme supported by Arcadia

hierarchyInspection.finding: The only explicitly named Berkut entries belong to series EAP1075/1/85. No hierarchy text matches Pul or the Cyrillic root Пул. Individual item titles in file 2 (LB) and file 97 (Uncategorised) supply no additional Berkut or Puljay entry.
hierarchyInspection.caveat: Absence from this collection hierarchy is not proof that no Puljay photograph exists elsewhere or within unidentified survey material.

records.primaryIdentityCriterion: UNESCO describes the central Berkut-Kala castle as a 100 x 100 m square, with preserved northern, western and eastern walls and a donjon in the south-eastern corner. The broader oasis contains many separate castles/manors.
records.result: All 24 public manifest image bodies were downloaded and visually inspected. Frames 1 and 2 are envelope/reverse images. Frames 3 to 24 show aerial survey views with desert, vegetation, dunes and some excavated rectangular buildings. No frame establishes the exact central destination castle clearly enough for approval.
records.caution: Do not promote an oasis survey, a different manor or a repeated print as the exact Berkut-Kala destination, and do not count duplicate prints as distinct photographs.
records.technicalCaution: Actual downloaded JPEGs are 1200 x 798, while manifest canvas dimensions are 4256 x 2832. Source dimensions are preserved separately by the manifest and must not be claimed as downloaded dimensions.

searches: site:eap.bl.uk Pulzhay OR Puljay OR Puljai OR Пульжай OR Пульджай
Full EAP1075 hierarchy text search for Pul and Пул
records.result: No exact named Puljay/Pulzhay/Puljai entry was found in the indexed British Library search or complete EAP1075 hierarchy. Broad southern Ustyurt series EAP1075/1/77 names Chash-Tepe, Shemakha-Kala, Dev-Kesken-Kala and Shaitan Island; it does not identify Puljay and was not substituted.
records.remainingGap: An exact subject photograph with primary identity and reuse evidence remains needed. The archive collection may contain unidentified or unindexed material, which has not been mapped to this destination.
